import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import io

# Dataset provided as a string
data = """amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5
"""

# Read the data into a pandas DataFrame
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(data))

# Set a clean aesthetic style for the plots
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot to visualize the relationships between amount, hour_of_day,
# and transaction_type.
# Since 'is_fraud' is constant (0) in this specific dataset, it won't provide
# visual differentiation, but we can note its value in the title.
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
scatter_plot = sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x="hour_of_day",
    y="amount",
    hue="transaction_type",  # Differentiate transaction types by color
    size="amount",           # Use amount to vary marker size, emphasizing larger transactions
    sizes=(100, 800),        # Range of marker sizes
    alpha=0.7,               # Slightly transparent markers
    edgecolor="w",           # White edge for markers
    linewidth=1              # Edge line width
)

# Add title and labels for clarity
plt.title(
    "Transaction Amount vs. Hour of Day by Transaction Type\n"
    f"(All transactions are non-fraudulent: is_fraud={df['is_fraud'].iloc[0]})",
    fontsize=16
)
plt.xlabel("Hour of Day (0-23)", fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel("Transaction Amount", fontsize=12)

# Ensure x-axis ticks are at integer hours for better readability
plt.xticks(range(0, 24, 2))
plt.xlim(-1, 24) # Set x-axis limits to clearly show all hours

# Improve legend title and position
plt.legend(title="Transaction Type", bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1), loc='upper left', borderaxespad=0)

# Adjust layout to prevent labels from overlapping and ensure everything fits
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the plot to a file
plt.savefig("output.png")
